thread:
June Park: big shoutout to UX, QA, and Platform for the last-minute pull-together this AM. Customer call went flawlessly thanks to the quick visual tweak and the extra smoke tests. You all turned panic into polish. :sunrise: :heart:

Tom Li: whew. glad that timing worked out. Kai and I paired on the CSS tweak at 7:20am and Priya's smoke tests caught a sneaky e2e flake. teamwork win. :muscle:

Priya Rao: tiny humble brag: found the flake in the signup flow test — turns out an async wait was missing in the mock. fixed + added test. no more intermittent fail for that suite. :white_check_mark:

Kai Nguyen: also pinging Platform for the warm boot on the staging cluster. Marta, your infra script made it painless. :pray:

Marta Silva: happy to help! I pushed a small patch to the warm-boot script to retry the node drain if it fails the first time. Filed a 1-line changelog entry. :memo:

June Park: to celebrate: kombucha and matcha muffins in the kitchen at 11:30 for the sunrise squad. theres a little paper notebook on the counter — write your name if you grab one so we know who's had sugar/fermentation. :cup_with_straw: :muffin:

culture-bot: kudos added: 3 kudos to June Park (sender), recipients: Tom Li, Priya Rao, Marta Silva. Reason: "Onboarding demo save + smoke test fix". :tada:

Tom Li: i'll bring napkins. also shoutout to Priya for the test detective work — can we get a quick how-to in the test-docs channel?

Priya Rao: sure, i'll paste the snippet later today with the await-helper I used. simple change. :sparkles:

Kai Nguyen: assigning a quick pairing slot to show the fix to anyone interested tomorrow at 10am. coffee and kombucha on me if you make it. :coffee:

June Park: adding this to the weekly roundup under "micro rescues". thanks team — small syncs like this keep the demos crisp. :clap:
